metadata.question: Did the cropland around the North Crimean Canal in Ukraine apprear browner between June 3 and July 19, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare cropland appearance (likely vegetation health/greenness) between two dates: June 3 and July 19, 2023 - Location: North Crimean Canal in Ukraine (approximately 46°N, 33-34°E) - Use Sentinel-2 for high-resolution optical imagery - "Browner" suggests decrease in vegetation/greenness, so NDVI or RGB comparison 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want to see actual ground conditions - Use Sentinel-2 cloud masking via QA60 band 3. Logic: - Compare NDVI or greenness between the two dates - If NDVI decreased (became less green/more brown), answer A - If NDVI increased or stayed same, answer B - Watch for: no data (C1), no valid pixels after cloud mask (C2), calculation failure (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define region around North Crimean Canal const canal = ee.Geometry.Point([33.8, 46.0]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around canal area // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Get image for June 3, 2023 const date1 = '2023-06-03'; const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(canal) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log('June 3 images found: ' + size1); if (size1 === 0) { // Try wider date range const col1_wider = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(canal) .filterDate('2023-06-01', '2023-06-05') .map(maskS2clouds); const size1_wider = col1_wider.size().getInfo(); console.log('June 1-5 images found: ' + size1_wider); if (size1_wider === 0) { console.log('No data for early June 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Get image for July 19, 2023 const date2 = '2023-07-19'; const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(canal) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log('July 19 images found: ' + size2); if (size2 === 0) { // Try wider date range const col2_wider = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(canal) .filterDate('2023-07-17', '2023-07-21') .map(maskS2clouds); const size2_wider = col2_wider.size().getInfo(); console.log('July 17-21 images found: ' + size2_wider); if (size2_wider === 0) { console.log('No data for mid-July 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Calculate NDVI for both periods function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const img1 = (size1 > 0 ? col1 : ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(canal) .filterDate('2023-06-01', '2023-06-05') .map(maskS2clouds)) .map(addNDVI) .median(); const img2 = (size2 > 0 ? col2 : ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(canal) .filterDate('2023-07-17', '2023-07-21') .map(maskS2clouds)) .map(addNDVI) .median(); // Check pixel counts const count1 = img1.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log('June valid pixels: ' + count1); console.log('July valid pixels: ' + count2); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI const ndvi1 = img1.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: canal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndvi2 = img2.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: canal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log('June NDVI: ' + (ndvi1 !== null ? ndvi1.toFixed(3) : 'null')); console.log('July NDVI: ' + (ndvi2 !== null ? ndvi2.toFixed(3) : 'null')); if (ndvi1 === null || ndvi2 === null || ndvi1 > 1 || ndvi1 < -1 || ndvi2 > 1 || ndvi2 < -1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation'); console.log('C3'); return; } const ndviChange = ndvi2 - ndvi1; console.log('NDVI change: ' + ndviChange.toFixed(3)); // Browner means NDVI decreased (less green vegetation) if (ndviChange < -0.05) { console.log('Vegetation became browner (NDVI decreased)'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Vegetation did not become significantly browner'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
